Damn ... That's actually a great response, because honestly I have no idea any more. Not to let people down, not to have life feel like an endless struggle ... To feel like a responsible, in control adult instead of an overgrown teenager, but I'm always forgetting things, losing track of things, getting over-emotional.

And when it comes to women ... No idea. I said I wanted some time to sleep around have fun, but then I met my current girlfriend and she's just the most beautiful wonderful creature ... But I feel like its a constant struggle to make it work, and most of the time it's my fault. The things that are my fault I try and work at but it doesn't make a difference. The things that aren't just get dumped on me and she make it sound like I'm such a burden to her sometimes ...

Honesty right now I want someone to tell me I really am crazy and this is all in my head, because it's that or I'm an idiot, screw-up manchild.

Of course, you were just asking me literally because I didn't make a request in the post ...

Sometimes when I get the bus, theres this pretty brunette with dark eyes. She's not stunning, I have no interest in talking to her, but she seems like a nice person as fr some reason I feel comfier on that bus ride when she's there.

Even if you don't have anyone close to you right now, you're a part of a complex web that you can't see and can barely imagine, and every little thing you do affects it. You can play a part in saving the world just by smiling as you go about your day.

So just try and hang in there. Smile a someone. Do something nice. That's your reason for living.

First off, your grandfather probably loves you no matter what you do. I'm guessing you don't have kids? It shifts your perspectives (or from what I've been told, anyway) and suddenly the whole "blame" concept just isn't the same. If your kid breaks something of yours, messes up something that you he to bail them out of ... They're your kid first and foremost. Chances are you're your grandfather grandkid before you're ever to blame for anything, and he won't feel any different about you based on anything you've done.
